headline: Nigeria's Lagos-Calabar Highway to Boost GDP by 2% and Create 250,000 Jobs
summary: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu stated that the Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway could contribute 2% to the nation's GDP through trade, tourism, and industrial activity while generating 250,000 jobs.
why: Large-scale infrastructure investments in developing economies often stimulate domestic economic activity, trade logistics, and regional employment, directly influencing national macroeconomic performance and construction sector growth.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Large infrastructure projects are projected by government officials to expand national GDP and employment.
